stories.headline: OpenAI launches Wallet for agent purchases
stories.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet with American Express, Mastercard and Visa. It uses substitute payment credentials and requires purchase approval/security checks. Initial availability is limited to eligible US Pro users in dots.

stories.headline: AI tops risks cited in Fed stability survey
stories.summary: AI was cited by 87% of market contacts in the Fed's latest financial-stability survey, up from 50% in spring. Concerns include valuations, cyberattacks and complex financing. This is a risk-perception survey, not a crash forecast.

stories.headline: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop; delays persist
stories.summary: The FAA lifted Friday's nationwide departure stop at 8:15 PM after air-traffic communications problems. Operations resumed gradually; displaced aircraft and crews may disrupt schedules for days. The underlying cause remains under investigation.

stories.headline: White House plans Trump–Xi–Putin arms discussion
stories.summary: The White House says Trump will raise nuclear-arms reductions with Xi and Putin in China on November 19. A senior US official expects no agreement; Chinese and Russian engagement on that agenda was not independently confirmed.

stories.headline: Trump may defer Iran strikes, sources tell Reuters
stories.summary: Reuters reports Trump has discussed withholding further Iran attacks absent new provocations. The account relies on unnamed sources, not a binding ceasefire announcement; escalation options remain available.
